description: The fixed, a-priori validation gates the skeptic agent applies to every experiment. Thresholds are pre-registered and never relaxed to admit a favored signal. APPROVED requires ALL gates to pass.

gates.rule: net Sharpe @25bps > 0 AND net ann return @25bps > 0
net Sharpe @25bps > SPY Sharpe over the same periods
net Sharpe @25bps > equal-weight survivorship-aware universe Sharpe
net Sharpe @25bps minus permuted-signal placebo Sharpe >= placebo_sharpe_margin
signal uses only data <= t; forward return realized over (t, t+1]; structural check passes
net max drawdown >= dd_floor AND not more than dd_rel_spy deeper than SPY

status_rules.WEAK: positive net and beats SPY and placebo-clean, but fails EW-universe and/or drawdown and/or turnover
status_rules.REJECTED: fails after costs, underperforms SPY, fails placebo, or fails leakage
status_rules.NEEDS_FULL_PANEL: insufficient history or cross-section to judge

multiple_testing.note: The director discounts winners by the number of experiments tested; lucky single-winner results among many are not promotable without out-of-sample confirmation.
